name: 32444 · Lynn Haven, FL
findings: ZIP 32444 (Lynn Haven) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32444 (Lynn Haven) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32444 (Lynn Haven) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).
